title: Nimble Croatian Cod Broth
description: A briny, tender cod broth that showcases a citrusy yuzu cure and warm water, perfect for a sugar‑free friendly meal.
instructions: Pat the cod fillets dry with paper towels.
Season the fillets with 1 tsp sea salt and 1 tsp yuzu juice, then let them cure for 15 minutes.
Rinse the fillets gently and pat dry again.
In a large pot, add warm water and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add sliced onion, carrot, celery, bay leaf, peppercorns, and 1 tsp sea salt to the pot.
Insert the cured cod fillets into the simmering broth.
Reduce heat to low and cover, letting the cod cook for 12 minutes, until the flesh flakes easily.
Remove the cod from the broth and let it rest for 3 minutes before flaking.
Stir in yuzu zest and chopped dill, adjust seasoning with salt if needed, and serve hot.
Clean the pot immediately after use to maintain the broth's freshness.
